items.quote: I have a copy of Meditations in most rooms I spend time in.

source.note: Verbatim in the fs.blog transcript (episode "AI Agents, Better Decisions, and the Future of Work"; YouTube title "Tobi Lütke: The Skills AI Makes More Valuable"; host Shane Parrish; published 2026-09-15). Surrounding words: "I mean obviously I am a Meditations fan… and I have a copy of Meditations in most rooms I spend time in. So I just do some random reading and it's magical how it's somehow relevant to something I'm wrestling with." The t=3802 timestamp link was supplied by Anders; the exact second was not verified. His older tweet "My most read book." (x.com/tobi/status/1258575206483922950) has been DELETED by its author: do not link it.

items.quote: One of my favorite books of all time.

source.note: Confirmed via X's public syndication endpoint: 2014-02-22, @naval, reply "@semil Have you read Meditations? One of my favorite books of all time."

items.quote: The basics are pretty simple, but living them consistently is hard. So returning to the same key texts will serve you well.

source.note: Verbatim in the raw HTML of https://dailystoic.com/dhh/ (DHH answering "What are some books… the Daily Stoic audience will enjoy"). The same answer gives his order: A Guide to the Good Life, On the Shortness of Life, Meditations, The Daily Stoic. The quote is about Stoic texts in general.
